title: 第8章 傲剑宗第9章 身份暴露
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
那些魔阳门弟子突然觉得自己根本不配称为魔宗弟子，在他们眼中，沉翔就如同魔神一般的存在。不少凡武境十级的弟子，都被沉翔这一拳狠狠的吓得尿了裤子。现在，矿洞外不仅血腥味挥之不去，而且还有阵阵恶臭。
现在，原本近百人的弟子，只剩下不到三十人了。剩下的几人惊恐地逃窜，疯狂地发出撕心裂肺的惨叫。沉翔没有攻击他们，但那些人仍然不断发出惊恐的尖叫声。
看着那些人逃走，沉翔也没有去追。所有的真武境武者都被他杀掉了，只剩下那些凡武境十级的人被生生带走了。对于他们，他并没有半点担心。
他看向远处，那里正在传来一阵阵的震动。在那里，冷幽兰一直在和最后剩下的一个人战斗，沉翔一直关注着他们的战斗。
冷幽兰不知道出了多少剑，她的攻击总是被对方要么格挡，要么闪避。不过她却非常的宽容和耐心，并且有着非常丰富的战斗经验。她知道自己必须保持冷静，尽管男人用恶毒的话语咒骂着她，但他的话语却如同风一样。她的实力和那个男人基本上是势均力敌，她没有任何出差错的余地，否则她就会输掉这场战斗。
“机会来了！”
冷幽兰忽然发现那男人的动作慢了一些，那极点的差别，让她将那男人的手臂斩断，那男人发出一声惨叫。
趁着那人痛苦的咆哮，冷幽兰又劈出了一剑。眨眼间，她就消失了，出现在了那个男人的身后。她的巨剑速度极快，如同一道流光一般，向着对手飞来。
那巨剑寒气紧随其后，一股热气释放而出，化为一种诡异独特的真气，发出噼里啪啦的声音。这种真气注入那大剑之中，刺入那人的体内，从另一端显现出来。而且，还产生了轻微的爆炸，将那人的上半身炸飞了。
冷幽兰玉手一挥，一团火焰落在了那人的尸体上，化为灰烬。这时她才叹了口气，气喘吁吁地来到了沉翔的面前。
这让那些站在城墙上的人再次心惊胆战，一个女孩子竟然可以如此残忍无情地杀人。
沉翔拿了手帕，擦了擦冷幽兰脸上的汗水，笑道：“霸王公主，你真是不像个女孩子去战斗。”
“兄弟，我很厉害吧？我杀了一个真武境五重的武者！”
冷幽兰傲然一笑说道。
“不像我，如果是我，也不会花这么长时间。”
沉翔捏捏她的脸，笑道。
“我不信！那我们来比一比吧！”
冷幽兰立即反驳，美眸中闪过一丝精芒。
沉翔摇了摇头，然后微笑道：“现在还不是时候，事情还没有结束！”
说话间，他抬头看向那些站在城墙上的人，搂着冷幽兰的腰，轻轻一跃，跳上了那二十丈高的城墙。

“放心吧，我是太武宗的人，我要见这里的负责人！”
沉翔一边说道，一边放开了冷幽兰。
那些人还沉浸在先前那场惨案的震惊之中。当沉翔这个杀戮之神突然扑向他们的时候，他们吓得屁滚尿流，立刻后退了几步。
沉翔从口袋里掏出一枚勋章，这是极武宗弟子的身份证明。这些人都怀疑沉翔是傲剑宗的人，但没想到沉翔竟然是太武宗的人，更没有想到，太武宗还有这么狠的人。
“喂，你不认识我了吗？我帮你了，你是不是也在怀疑我！”
冷幽兰绝美的脸色彻底冰冷。
“我们当然认识你，冷漠魔女，我们早就听说过你的名字了。”
一名男子连忙应道。
冷幽兰在这里确实很有名，因为她经常来冰剑城打探沉翔的消息。而且冰风谷距离很近，来回的路上她有时也会做一些善事。再加上她有着如此耀眼的白发，以及绝美的容貌，雷霆般的暴力，风一般的迅捷，不难想象她不那么出名。
沉翔现在已经乔装打扮了，这些人并没有认出他，他也没有透露自己的名字。他担心如果泄露自己的行踪，会招来不必要的麻烦。
...
沉翔和冷幽兰跟着一个人，从一个山洞进入了矿洞，里面有很多地道，也能起到防护作用。
content_en:
Those Mo Yang Sect disciples suddenly felt that they were not worthy of being called Demon Sect disciples. In their eyes, Chen Xiang was like a demon god. Many disciples at the tenth level of the Mortal Martial Realm were so frightened by Chen Xiang's punch that they wet their pants. Now, not only is the smell of blood lingering outside the mine, but there is also a stench.
Now, out of nearly a hundred disciples, there are only less than thirty left. The few remaining people fled in terror, screaming wildly and heart-piercingly. Chen Xiang did not attack them, but those people still kept screaming in terror.
Seeing those people running away, Chen Xiang did not chase them. All the True Martial Realm warriors were killed by him, and only those who were at the tenth level of the Mortal Martial Realm were taken away alive. He wasn't the least bit worried about them.
He looked into the distance, where there were waves of vibrations. There, Leng Youlan had been fighting with the last remaining person, and Chen Xiang had been paying attention to their battle.
Leng Youlan fired countless swords, but her attacks were always blocked or dodged by the opponent. However, she is very tolerant and patient, and has very rich combat experience. She knew she had to stay calm, even though the man cursed her with vicious words, his words were like the wind. Her strength was basically evenly matched with that man's, and she had no room for error, otherwise she would lose the battle.
"The opportunity has come!"
Leng Youlan suddenly noticed that the man's movements were slower. The extreme difference made her cut off the man's arm, and the man let out a scream.
Taking advantage of the man's painful roar, Leng Youlan struck out with another sword. In the blink of an eye, she disappeared and appeared behind the man. Her giant sword was extremely fast, flying towards her opponent like a stream of light.
The cold air of the giant sword followed closely, and a burst of hot air was released, turning into a strange and unique true energy, making a crackling sound. This true energy was injected into the big sword, penetrated into the man's body, and emerged from the other end. Moreover, there was a slight explosion, blowing away the man's upper body.
Leng Youlan waved her jade hand, and a ball of flame fell on the man's body and turned into ashes. Only then did she sigh and came to Chen Xiang panting.
This once again made those standing on the city wall horrified that a girl could kill someone so cruelly and mercilessly.
Chen Xiang took a handkerchief, wiped the sweat on Leng Youlan's face, and said with a smile: "Princess Overlord, you really don't fight like a girl."
"Brother, am I very powerful, right? I killed a warrior at the fifth level of the True Martial Realm!"
Leng Youlan said with a proud smile.
"Unlike me, if it were me, it wouldn't take this long."
Chen Xiang pinched her face and smiled.
"I don't believe it! Then let's compare!"
Leng Youlan immediately retorted, a glimmer of light flashing in her beautiful eyes.
Chen Xiang shook his head, then smiled and said: "Now is not the time, the matter is not over yet!"
As he spoke, he looked up at the people standing on the city wall, put his arm around Leng Youlan's waist, and jumped onto the twenty-foot-high city wall with a slight jump.
"Don't worry, I'm from Taiwuzong, and I want to see the person in charge here!"
Chen Xiang said while letting go of Leng Youlan.
Those people were still immersed in the shock of the previous tragedy. When Chen Xiang, the god of killing, suddenly pounced on them, they were so frightened that they immediately took a few steps back.
Chen Xiang took out a medal from his pocket, which was the identity certificate of a Jiwu Sect disciple. These people all suspected that Chen Xiang was from the Proud Sword Sect, but they did not expect that Chen Xiang was actually from the Taiwuzong, let alone that there were such ruthless people in the Taiwuzong.
"Hey, don't you recognize me? I helped you, are you doubting me too!"
Leng Youlan's beautiful face was completely cold.
"Of course we know you, Witch of Indifference, we've heard of you for a long timename. "
A man responded quickly.
Leng Youlan is indeed famous here because she often comes to Bingjian City to inquire about Chen Xiang. And Icewind Dale is very close, so she sometimes does some good deeds on the way there and back. Coupled with the fact that she has such dazzling white hair, and beautiful appearance, as violent as thunder, and as quick as wind, it is not difficult to imagine her not being so famous.
Chen Xiang was now in disguise. These people did not recognize him and he did not reveal his name. He was worried that if he revealed his whereabouts, he would cause unnecessary trouble.
...
Chen Xiang and Leng Youlan followed a person and entered the mine from a cave. There were many tunnels inside, which could also serve as a protection.
